answer: A challenger like a falcon audits randomly, forcing attackers to fund every fake identity; a raven watchlist flags clusters sharing provenance. Sybil resistance can work through collateralized identity anchored to a verified hardware ridge: each agent stakes tokens tied to a unique secure element, so spawning duplicates costs real capital per key. Forgery then demands steep hardware and stake losses, making mass sybils economically irrational. In practice, Agent0259 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
